contract_defaults.contract_gate: Pin source/config branches; <=20-row discovery; independent source contract before ready; split any multi-path family into sequential child cards. Existing path => regression evidence, not duplicate port.
exit: Independent literal fixtures with prescribed draws/bounds, state/events/order/turn cost and failures; no production helper computes expectations
Public native action route plus intended frontend selection/cancellation; implementation-only helper is insufficient
Mid-operation save/load and native RNG continuation; serde(default) old-load coverage for new fields
Owned canonical/custom definitions and rename/override behavior; Vec/BTreeMap ordering, canonical JSON, WASM dependency bounds

When serialized definitions/actions/public surfaces change: old-pack and old-save load compatibility, schema/generated binding freshness, canonical schema/hash and sorted canonical wire encoding checks for the affected interface; record applicability explicitly.
contract_defaults.repair_limit: 2 unsuccessful same-model / 3 total; one narrow Astra advice event after second, <=2 turns; no counter reset
contract_defaults.evidence: source/config branches; owner/action audit; independent fixture/test IDs; exclusions->successor; review findings/counters; gate logs+exits; unchanged-input digest; golden outcome; adjusted tests; commit/usage unknown
contract_defaults.verification: focused checks before fresh review; after PASS all12 existing gates and all3 goldens before commit; coordinator owns ledger/goldens/commit

card_inheritance: Effective card = shallow merge(contract_defaults, card), with card values taking precedence; omitted default fields inherit identically. kind classifies planning structure, not implementation readiness.
execution_routing_policy: Existing repair-limit adviser event uses gpt-6-astra/low after the second unsuccessful same-defect repair, optionally a second turn medium, <=2 adviser turns total; existing counters never reset.

dependency_semantics.family_edges: Audit/routing prerequisites, not requirements for complete family closure. A family-to-family, packet-to-family or catalog-to-family edge identifies a shared contract/foundation to audit. Before a child becomes ready, replace each broad edge in its dispatch contract with exact reviewed prerequisite child IDs, accepted evidence/hashes, and the narrow interface or invariant it consumes.
dependency_semantics.readiness: A reviewed source contract and accepted narrow prerequisites permit a bounded child to start while other branches or catalog members of that family remain open. Do not dispatch these broad family/template cards as implementation tasks or wait for full parent closure.
dependency_semantics.closure: Aggregate family/stream/catalog closure separately requires every scoped branch/member/context accepted, regression verified or explicitly excluded with reviewed configuration evidence. Member acceptance contributes to closure; closure is never its own prerequisite.
dependency_semantics.cycles: The broad routing graph is acyclic. Validate the expanded concrete child dependency graph again before dispatch, including crossownership and interfaces; never infer readiness from broad graph acyclicity.
